folder.title: Backup folder
folder.description: Folder on the device where backups are stored. It is created if it does not exist; nested paths such as `Backups/HA` are allowed.

reauth_confirm.description: Your WD login expired. Sign in again with the same account. Your password is not stored.

api_gone.description: WD has switched off the My Cloud Home cloud API that this integration uses, so backups to this target no longer work. Use the local SMB option once it is available, and see the README for details.
